name: Clarice Clawnya
original_name: クラリス・クローニャ
source:
A first-year ballet student at Laikask Academy. 

She's talented enough at ballet dancing to have been admitted to the academy on a scholarship, though she's in a bit of a slump at the moment which is causing her grades to be on a downward trend.

As someone with a very serious personality who believes in the value of hard work, nobody practices with more zeal than she does.
Ballet is her life, and she has little interest in anything else.

She has severe androphobia, but wants to actively try to overcome this fear.
